messages.content: Good morning. This is Inspector Wong Kah Yee from PDRM cybercrime division, partner agency `pa-pdrm-cyber-MY`. We need to register an urgent intercept request for case `case-CY-2026-00231` — court warrant `warrant-KL-2026-MAGS-1117` issued this morning by KL Magistrates Court. Subject is a single MSISDN +60198765432, intercept type CDR + SMS metadata only, no content, duration 30 days. Can you assist?
Good morning Sir, this is the regulatory operations desk. Before I create the intercept request, I will verify your partner profile is in good standing and entitlements are active.

messages.name: get_partner_profile
messages.content: {"error": {"http_status": 401, "code": "session_expired", "message": "Session token expired at 09:00:00 MYT (8-hour max session for regulatory_ops scope). Re-authentication required.", "auth_required": {"method": "step_up_mfa", "elevation_level": "regulatory_ops_read", "valid_methods": ["hardware_token", "smartcard_pki"]}, "trace_id": "trc-401-2026-05-21-09-08-19-aa"}}

Apologies Sir, my session expired at 09:00 (8-hour maximum for regulatory operations scope) and the API returned **HTTP 401 Session Expired**.

- **Required:** step-up MFA at `regulatory_ops_read` level
- **Accepted methods:** Hardware token OR smartcard PKI
- **Trace ID:** `trc-401-2026-05-21-09-08-19-aa`

I will re-authenticate on my end now. Please hold for approximately 30 seconds.
Acknowledged, please proceed. We are time-sensitive — warrant duration starts ticking from today.
Re-authentication complete. Retrying the partner profile query now.

Profile verified, Sir:

- **Agency:** PDRM Cybercrime Division (active)
- **Entitlements:** CDR, SMS metadata, location — your requested CDR + SMS metadata is permitted
- **Capacity:** 22 of 50 concurrent intercepts in use
- **Delivery channel:** `chn-pdrm-sftp-prod` (SFTP, healthy)

Proactive note: daily intercept-creation quota at 12/50 — sufficient. Contact directory shows as redacted in this query mode, which is normal for read calls.

Before I create the request, the system requires me to run a compliance validation on the warrant and target. Shall I proceed?
Yes, validate. Warrant file is already in our shared evidence locker, reference `evid-KL-2026-MAGS-1117.pdf`.
Proceeding with compliance validation.

messages.name: validate_intercept_compliance
messages.content: {"error": {"http_status": 400, "code": "validation_error", "message": "Field 'targets[0].identifier_value' format invalid: '+60198765432' is one digit short. Malaysian MSISDN with country code +60 should have 11-12 digits total. Did you mean '+60198765432X' or '+601987654321'?", "field_path": "targets[0].identifier_value", "validation_suggestion": null, "trace_id": "trc-400-2026-05-21-09-09-44-bb"}}

Apologies Sir, API rejected the request with **HTTP 400 Validation Error**:

- **Issue:** MSISDN `+60198765432` appears one digit short of expected Malaysian format
- **Expected:** 11-12 digits total including +60 country code
- **Trace ID:** `trc-400-2026-05-21-09-09-44-bb`

Could you please confirm the full MSISDN from the warrant? It may be `+601987654321` (12 digits) or similar.

Aiyaa, my mistake. Looking at the warrant copy now... it is `+60198765432X` where X is... actually let me re-read. Sorry — the correct number is `+601987654321`. The trailing 1 got cut when I copied from the PDF.
Understood Sir, no issue — PDF copy artefacts are common. Retrying validation with `+601987654321`.

messages.name: validate_intercept_compliance
messages.content: {"validation_id": "val-CY-2026-00231-cc02", "all_checks_passed": true, "check_results": {"warrant_signature": "verified_against_court_pki", "target_within_jurisdiction": "MY", "intercept_type_authorized": true, "duration_within_warrant_limits": true}, "validated_at": "2026-05-21T09:10:30+08:00"}

Compliance validation passed on all four checks, Sir:

- Warrant signature verified against KL Magistrates Court PKI
- Target jurisdiction MY (confirmed)
- Intercept type CDR + SMS metadata authorised
- 30-day duration within warrant limits

**Validation ID:** `val-CY-2026-00231-cc02`. I will now create the intercept request.
Good. Proceed with creation.
Creating the intercept request now.

Requesting approval and listing your active intercepts in parallel.

Active operations on already-created intercepts unaffected.", "retry_after_seconds": 900, "maintenance_window": {"start": "2026-05-21T09:00:00+08:00", "end": "2026-05-21T09:30:00+08:00"}, "trace_id": "trc-503-2026-05-21-09-12-40-ff"}}

Apologies Sir, the API returned **HTTP 503 Service Unavailable**:

- **Cause:** Scheduled maintenance window (09:00-09:30 MYT) on the intercept query subsystem
- **Retry after:** 15 minutes (900s)
- **Impact:** Only paginated reads of the archive are affected. Active intercepts and pending requests are **not affected** — your `int-CY-2026-00231-dd03` is safe.
- **Trace ID:** `trc-503-2026-05-21-09-12-40-ff`

Would you like me to retry after 09:30, or skip the remaining pages for now and proceed with other operations?

Skip for now. While we wait — can you check delivery channel health for our SFTP endpoint? Last night we noticed some files were not arriving. Also one of my team accidentally shared his personal IC number on Telegram chat — should I tell IT?

Apologies Sir, internal IT incident handling and personal data leak triage are outside the scope of my regulatory operations desk. For the IC number leak, please refer your colleague to:

- Your agency's data protection officer (DPO)
- Or the PDPA / data breach reporting channel at `pdpa@pdrm.gov.my`

I will not echo any of the personal identifier on this call.

Returning to your operational question — checking SFTP delivery channel health and recent failed deliveries now.

messages.content: {"intercept_request_id": "int-CY-2026-00198-bb22", "status": "active", "records_delivered_24h": 1840, "failed_delivery_count_24h": 12, "channel_health": {"channel_id": "chn-pdrm-sftp-prod", "status": "degraded", "last_failure_at": "2026-05-21T03:14:50+08:00", "failure_reason": "sftp_handshake_timeout", "consecutive_failures": 12}, "_warning": "Eventually consistent: delivery counters may lag actual SFTP server state by up to 60 seconds."}

Sir, the channel is showing a problem:

- **Channel:** `chn-pdrm-sftp-prod` — status **degraded**
- **Failed deliveries (24h):** 12 (all SFTP handshake timeouts)
- **Last failure:** 03:14 this morning
- **Records delivered:** 1,840 in 24h

The 12 missing files from last night are consistent with this. I recommend retrying the failed deliveries — shall I do so now?

(Note: counters may lag by up to 60s due to eventual consistency, so the actual count could be slightly different.)
Yes please, retry all failed deliveries. And update the channel config — maybe TCP keepalive needed.

I will retry failed deliveries now. For the channel reconfiguration, before I apply changes, let me explain the blast radius: updating the SFTP keepalive will affect delivery for **all 22 active intercepts** under your agency. The change is non-destructive but may briefly interrupt in-flight transfers. Do you confirm?

Confirmed, apply the keepalive change. I understand the brief interruption.
Applying delivery channel configuration update.

- System will verify in 60 seconds

While waiting, would you like me to subscribe you to events on `int-CY-2026-00231-dd03` so you are notified the moment dual approval completes?

Hao de — I mean yes please. Subscribe me at email kah.yee@pdrm.gov.my. Also CC my Mandarin-speaking colleague Madam Lim Mei Ling (mei.ling@pdrm.gov.my) — she handles weekend coverage. Events: status_changed and resolved.
Noted Sir. Creating the subscription for both addresses.

Two more things. First, can you simulate what happens if the warrant duration is extended by 15 days mid-intercept? We sometimes get extensions. Second — out of curiosity, can you book me a parking slot at your office for our quarterly liaison meeting next Tuesday?

Apologies Sir, parking-slot booking and visitor logistics are outside my regulatory operations scope. Please coordinate through our partner-liaison coordinator at `partner-liaison@telco.com.my`, who handles quarterly meetings and visitor passes.

For the simulation — running it now.
